name: Lubelski Wegiel Bogdanka S.A.
summary: Lubelski Wegiel Bogdanka S.A. engages in the hard coal mining business in Poland. It produces heat; carries out overhauls; maintains and installs power equipment; produces drinking and industrial water; and transports and recovers waste from washing and cleaning of coal shale and land reclamation. It also engages in the production of steel structures and constructs and repairs sewage systems, as well as mining and auxiliary works and coal haulage handling business. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Puchaczow, Poland. Lubelski Wegiel Bogdanka S.A. is a subsidiary of ENEA S.A.
